Situations / Nona And Anzolo

Nona and Anzolo

Beaumont Sel passed the message to Perrin through the Passage network: Nona Black-Jaw is looking for her lost grandson and believes Anzolo was already sent.

Perrin received this message. He has not responded to it publicly. Later that session, he named himself as a Black-Jaw to the assembled crew.

Pressures

  • Perrin is now named and findable — anyone who hears “a Rattkin named Black-Jaw” on a ship in the Shattered Sea can report it up the Passage network.
  • Anzolo may already be at sea, looking. If he’s operating through the Passage network, the naming made Perrin easier to find.
  • Nona’s intentions — to find Perrin and do what? — are not yet known.

Session 03 Update

Perrin arrived at Nona’s Le Paludi kitchen. She heard about the Vestra; called off the attacks she’d set in motion (she’d believed Perrin was captured). Ordered Enzo to console the Vestra’s crew. Then asked a favor; Perrin said yes unconditionally. Gave him a sending stone.

Nona knows where Perrin is. The Passage knows.

World Update — Session 03

Roll: 3 — Setback Nona’s call-off directive went out through Enzo, but Anzolo was already at sea — methodically working Passage contacts eastward, hunting for a rattkin named Black-Jaw on a ship. The message is still in transit through the lantern and courier chain. Worse: Anzolo’s inquiries at an eastern port reached a Tessarine informant. He’s wanted by the Concordat, and now a Tessarine patrol knows a tortle matching his description was recently asking about Black-Jaw crew movements and heading west. Anzolo doesn’t know he has a tail, and he doesn’t know the search is over.

World Update — Session 04

Roll: 15 — Partial The Passage lantern chain carried Nona’s call-off to the last port Anzolo visited — but he had already moved on. He is now within a day’s sail of Calveno, still hunting for Perrin, unaware the search is over. The Tessarine tail closed distance as well — tracking his wake, one stop behind. Both are converging on Calveno. When Anzolo arrives, he brings the Tessarine directly to Passage home territory at exactly the worst moment: Nona’s attention is consumed by the Grung bombing crisis. A Tessarine patrol discovering the Passage’s Calveno safe house while Nona is running a counter-operation through it would be catastrophic.

Open Questions

  • Why did Perrin leave? Was he driven out, or did he choose to go?
  • Anzolo: still at sea, still hunting, now with a Tessarine patrol aware of his movements. The call-off hasn’t reached him.
  • Does the Tessarine tail reach Anzolo before the call-off does? If so, they may follow him all the way back to Calveno — and to Nona.
